title: Render encoder activation evidence in WebView
summary: Rendered backend-provided encoder activation evidence explicitly in the read-only WebView Settings capability panel and Launch backend-preflight summary. Operators can now see active descriptor-owned encoders, available-but-inactive encoders, and activation-unknown counts/lists without the frontend enabling hardware families or choosing FFmpeg flags.
reason: Encoder breadth remediation needs operator-visible launch preflight capability threading before dormant hardware families can be evaluated. The backend already owns the descriptor activation evidence; the WebView should display it clearly while preserving backend authority and fail-closed hardware activation boundaries.
behavior_before: Settings rendered read-only encoder/backend availability annotations, and Launch preflight exposed encoder capability detail mostly through the selected row payload. Activation counts/lists were present in backend payloads but not summarized explicitly in the WebView panels.
behavior_after: Settings summary lines and row evidence now include descriptor activation counts, active descriptor-owned encoders, available-but-inactive encoders, activation-unknown encoders, and per-row activation reasons. Launch backend preflight now summarizes the same backend detail across active targets and states that the WebView does not enable hardware families or choose FFmpeg flags.
